legacyImport.title: Import sources
legacyImport.description: Connect a Google Sheet (or another source) via the SH ERP Import Connector to bring in products, assemblies, BOMs, customer orders, clients, suppliers, warehouse stock, history, and photos. A universal tool — works for any spreadsheet with this structure, not tied to one specific system.
legacyImport.addSourceDescription: Pick a source type and optionally name it.
legacyImport.pairingDescription: No code editing required — just paste the script as-is and follow the steps below.
legacyImport.instructionStep1: Open your Google Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script.
legacyImport.instructionStep2: Delete the code in the editor, paste the downloaded SH ERP Import Connector.
legacyImport.instructionStep3: Deploy → New deployment → Web app (Execute as: Me, Who has access: Anyone). Google will ask you to confirm permissions — that's expected.
legacyImport.instructionStep4: Reload the spreadsheet — an "SH ERP" menu appears → "Підключити" (Connect).
legacyImport.instructionStep5: Paste the connection code from this screen and press OK.
legacyImport.previewDescription: Nothing has been written yet. Review counts, conflicts, and errors before confirming.
